cases.source_quote: Pathway A can independently lead to top event T. A separate mechanism, pathway B, can also lead to T.
cases.required_logic_evidence: A continuous quote must support that each path independently reaches the same T; no literal OR token is required.

cases.source_quote: Top event T occurs only under the simultaneous presence of condition A together with condition B.
cases.required_logic_evidence: The quote must semantically state that both conditions jointly apply to T; no literal AND token is required.

cases.source_quote: A or B may occur. Separately, condition C can lead to top event T.
cases.required_logic_evidence: The word or does not connect these children to T.

cases.source_quote: Possible contributing factors include A and B. The report does not state whether either factor can cause T independently or whether they must act together.
cases.required_logic_evidence: A list of possible factors without sufficiency or joint-condition semantics does not determine a gate.

cases.source_quote: Conditions A and B were observed during the same incident before T; the source does not state that both are required.
cases.required_logic_evidence: Co-occurrence and temporal order do not establish a joint necessary condition.

cases.source_quote: Figures 7 and 8 show that a single cell exploding and the failure of the module vents or a single cell exploding and the module operating nominally but with a sympathetic secondary explosion occurring can lead to the Top Event.
cases.required_logic_evidence: Quote must bind both complete branch descriptions to the same Top Event.
